scripts.build: npm run catalog && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: vitest run && node --test scripts/catalog-preview.check.mjs scripts/habitats.check.mjs scripts/compendium.check.mjs scripts/catalog-review.check.mjs
scripts.test:rust: npm run catalog && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib
scripts.bindings: npm run catalog && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml export_bindings
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html README.md && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
